description: This file defines the TypeScript interface 'PatchedConnectorConfigConfig' and related functions for JSON serialization/deserialization, representing configuration data for a connector in the Tandoor API project.

classes.name: PatchedConnectorConfigConfig
classes.description: Interface representing the configuration for a patched connector, including optional properties such as id, name, url, token, todoEntity, enabled, and flags for shopping list entry events, as well as support for description field and a read-only createdBy.

methods.name: instanceOfPatchedConnectorConfigConfig
methods.description: Type guard function to check if an object implements the PatchedConnectorConfigConfig interface.

methods.name: PatchedConnectorConfigConfigFromJSON
methods.description: Function to create a PatchedConnectorConfigConfig object from a JSON value.

methods.name: PatchedConnectorConfigConfigFromJSONTyped
methods.description: Function to create a PatchedConnectorConfigConfig object from JSON with optional discriminator handling.

methods.name: PatchedConnectorConfigConfigToJSON
methods.description: Function to serialize a PatchedConnectorConfigConfig object to JSON.
